text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I was a child, my dream was to be
the very
best racer.

text_block_list.name: Human Girl
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... wheeze...

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You're too slow, Etsie! Hurry up or I'll
leave you
behind!

text_block_list.name: Human Girl
text_block_list.text: W-wait up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not once was I able to catch up to my
friend.
Seeing her tail flit about so far
ahead, I felt the
limits of being human,
and my pride was
shattered to pieces.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! I win!

text_block_list.name: Human Girl
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... wheeze...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was so frustrating. The simple fact that
I was
human put an unbreakable ceiling
on my
potential. I couldn't stand the
absurdity of it all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But still, I found my friend's running
more
captivating than anything in the
world...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In my young mind, I believed that she
was the
fastest, the strongest, and the
most beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At least, that's what I wanted to believe.

text_block_list.name: Human Girl
text_block_list.text:
Is it true? Are you really quitting the
kids' racing
club?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I promised my mom I'd quit if I
didn't win
yesterday's race and become
club leader...

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...You supported me all this time, Etsie.
Sorry I let
you down...

text_block_list.name: Human Girl
text_block_list.text: B-but you won so many times! Then you come in second place once and this is what happens?!

text_block_list.name: Human Girl
text_block_list.text: Sure, our new leader's fast, and she's finished first in a bunch of big races... but I know you're better than her!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe. Her record's not perfect. And
she didn't
even hit the board plenty of
times.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I... sometimes I think I'm
better
than her too! But... but...

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
She won yesterday! ...She pulls through
when it
really counts. That's why I have
no choice but to
accept it.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
The other club members, the teachers...
They've
all embraced her as leader.
Everyone feels the
same way!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...My mom was against me becoming a
racer from
the very beginning. If I'm not
the best in the club,
I'm not allowed to
keep running.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
And I didn't win yesterday! ...So it's all
over!

text_block_list.name: Human Girl
text_block_list.text: W-wait!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I knew how talented she truly was. I
knew it
better than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I was jealous of her. I fixated on her,
studied
her—but I couldn't beat her. She
crushed me
every time, so I knew exactly
how good she was.

text_block_list.name: Human Girl
text_block_list.text: I said wait!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What if club leader tryouts weren't a
one-time
only deal?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Like in baseball, how teams play
multiple times to
find out who's really
the best.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As that same thought ran through my
mind over
and over... I realized that I
never once wavered in
my belief that my
friend was the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: (That's why... That's why I...)

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Greetings to everyone watching this special broadcast! I'm Otonashi from Twinkle Monthly.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
This broadcast is being brought to you
live across
different platforms through
various media outlets.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
To all our viewers watching online, we'll
be
responding to your questions and
comments, so
be sure to send yours in!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, it started! Pretty incredible how
they stream
this stuff on Umasta.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I saw on TV and online that there's going
to be
some sort of important
announcement. Wonder
what it could
be...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I pass by the station, I see that a
large crowd
has gathered.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, they're showing something on the
station
jumbotron.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
There's apparently a big announcement
today. I
saw a full-page ad about it in
the sports paper.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I saw it in a racing magazine! That
same ad's
been in all the magazines
recently, right?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Now without further delay, let's get
straight to
the matter at hand.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I, Etsuko Otonashi, along with Twinkle Monthly and all the other media outlets that love Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Would like to formally announce a
brand-new
race series—the Twinkle Star
Climax!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: This race series is a media-led initiative made possible with the cooperation of Twinkle Monthly and several other news organizations!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, it looks like we have a comment
from a
Tracen Academy student. Thank
you for your
question!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"I'm really looking forward to the new
race series!
What makes a media-led
initiative special when
compared to
regular races?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Excellent question! Now, my explanation
here
may come across as presumptuous
to some.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
But that's exactly why I'd like you all to
hear me
out! The Twinkle Star Climax...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Will be the series to decide the greatest

Umamusume of them all!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Of course, this will be just one vision,
determined
by us in the media, of what
it means to be the
"greatest."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
But when all of you watching this
broadcast think
of the "greatest," which
runner immediately
comes to mind?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Well, well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What is it, Brian? Has this new race
series piqued
your interest?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Maybe. Depends what else they have to
say.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
...The Derby Umamusume, perhaps? The
Triple
Crown champion?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
An undefeated runner? Or perhaps one
who raced
at the highest level for the
longest time?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: For this race series, we're defining the "greatest" as the Umamusume who can prove her strength most consistently!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Prove her strength consistently, huh?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Take, for example, the Japanese Derby,
a race
which can only be run once in a
lifetime.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Those who set their sights on the Derby
put
everything on the line, working to
put even luck
itself on their side.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
The winner of such a race is, without
doubt, the
"greatest" in one sense.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
However, luck is undeniably a factor in
how any
one race plays out. And while
no what-if scenarios
are recorded in the
history books...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: What if that race could be redone? I'm sure the thought has crossed everyone's mind at least once, yes?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I, too, have entertained such hypotheticals. And that is precisely why...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Star Climax will utilize a

points-based system!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
A carefully selected lineup of talented
runners
will compete three times under
identical
conditions to earn points
determined by their
placing.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
What's more, there will be races to cover
every
category you can think of—sprint,
mile, medium,
long, dirt...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
In short, this series requires that runners

consistently prove their strength by
fighting their
way to the top multiple
times!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Heh... This sure is a big-time series.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even if I set my sights on Oguri and
enter the
same races as her, there's no
tellin' what everyone
else is gonna do.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: So I'm in your sights...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It was just a hypothetical! Don't go
readin' too
much into it!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What I'm tryin' to say is, we'll be able to
do stuff
in this series that we couldn't up
till now.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That's true. We can have three different

after-parties.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Not dat kinda stuff! Quit it with da
quips! ...What
I mean is there'll be more
room for counter strats.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
After the first race, everyone's gonna
know each
other's game plans. There
won't be as many
openings to exploit.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Luck won't matter and bluffs won't work.
It's
gonna be a contest of pure ability.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So that's why this series is supposed to
prove who
the greatest is? I get it now.
You're good at
explaining things, Tama.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The reporter is basically saying the same
thing, so
I'm sure you've got the right
idea.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"As such, this series will reduce the luck
factor to
a minimum, resulting in a
contest of pure ability."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What?! She was sayin' da exact same
stuff as me
da whole time?! My
explanation was pointless!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
To all viewers across Japan, I present the

question to you once again.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Are you ready to find out, once and for
all, who
the greatest really is?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Are you ready for more promotion than
ever?
More cameras than ever? Racing
on a scale like
you've never seen
before?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Well I am, so I say it's time to decide the
greatest
Umamusume of all time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The crowd on the street is swept into an
uproar.
Just then, as the word "greatest"
is sparking the
imaginations of everyone
around me...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzt! Bzzt!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Greetings, Trainer! Were you watching
that
broadcast? Return to the academy
at once!
Posthaste!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After hurrying over to Director
Akikawa's office, I
listen to what she and
Tazuna have to say.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...And so, here at Tracen Academy, we'll
be doing
everything in our power to
facilitate this new race
series!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
That said, doing so should be quite
simple! And
also exceedingly difficult! If
you continue your
heroic exploits in the
Twinkle Series...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Then eventually you will receive a letter
of
invitation to the Twinkle Star Climax!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Let's do our very best as we aim to enter
the new
series, Trainer. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Essentially, they want me to push
onward in order
to make an impact on
the grandest stage of the
era—the
Twinkle Star Climax!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>!
Do you
have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Oh, so you were watching? I'm Etsuko Otonashi, a reporter for Twinkle Monthly.
choice_data_list: Yes... Oh, from the broadcast earlier!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to offer my personal thanks for
Tracen
Academy's immense support.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
And I'm expecting great things from
your trainee
as a potential contender in
the Twinkle Star
Climax!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
No need to be modest. I've heard you're
the
up-and-comer Director Akikawa has
such high
expectations for.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Now, could you please share your
thoughts as you
aim to compete for the
title of the "greatest"?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Simply amazing! The resolve to exhaust
every
ounce of effort from every fiber in
your body to
bestow the title of
"greatest" upon your partner!
choice_data_list: I-I'll give it everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: That was so moving I lost my composure!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: I simply must publish an article on you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, there's little doubt that
entering the
Twinkle Star Climax would
be a great honor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If <chrname> dreams of one
day
holding the title of the "greatest,"
then it might
be a challenge worth
taking up!
